title: Soil block molding press
engineering: Eight-cell SVG and assumed ejection model. Higher leverage reduces handle force from 84.42 N to 37.52 N and requires 202.5 mm travel.
physical_check: Mold 80 blocks and require 75 eject intact and survive watering. Record mix and peak force.

title: Drip-lateral flush header
engineering: Eight-row flow model gives 0.355 m/s minimum at lateral ends versus 0.183 m/s with uniform bore. Uniform bore passes the lateral limit under individual flushing.
physical_check: Run tracer across all eight rows at measured flow. Check outlet velocity and leakage.

title: School plankton tow net
engineering: Cut dimensions and inert verification schedule predict 97% model bead retention with the finer aperture versus 34% with coarse stock.
physical_check: Gauge the ordered mesh and bench-flow reference beads with at least 90% capture.

title: Batch fry counting flume
engineering: Ten synthetic batches each accept 40 single silhouettes and defer five merged events. Fully overlapped pairs cannot be resolved by one view.
physical_check: Blind-count ten batches of 50 inert silhouettes and report error and overlaps.

title: Aquaculture blower-loss alarm
engineering: Ten synthetic switch traces alarm in 5 s. Derated nominal battery predicts 99.50 min versus 11.53 min for the small-battery control.
physical_check: Drop pressure ten times and verify 30 s onset and 15 minutes powered by the battery.

title: Small-lot bean sorting belt
engineering: 70 mm/s belt yields 2.571 s modeled exposure for all 30 markers against 1.50 s in the faster control.
physical_check: Time a 3 kg sample with 30 marked defects. Record misses and lodges under fixed light.

title: Fruit firmness comparison stand
engineering: Three-load synthetic signal and travel model. Stiffer fixture reduces depth error from 0.8387 to 0.3065 mm.
physical_check: Compare force at three reference loads and depth within 0.5 mm. Repeat on uniform foam.
